name: Conflict · De-escalation
description: For heated conversations: anger and threat, blame and insults, and the moves that calm things down.

detectors.name: Blames
detectors.what: the speaker blames another person for a problem

detectors.name: Personal insult
detectors.what: the speaker insults or belittles a person

detectors.name: Absolute language
detectors.what: the speaker uses always or never about another person

detectors.name: Asks to calm down
detectors.what: the speaker asks someone to calm down, lower their voice or slow down

detectors.name: Sets a boundary
detectors.what: the speaker says what they will or will not accept
detectors.example: I won't continue if you shout.

detectors.name: Finds common ground
detectors.what: the speaker points out something both sides agree on or want

detectors.name: Clear request
detectors.what: the speaker asks for a specific change in behaviour
detectors.example: Please tell me before you change the plan.

detectors.name: Empathy
detectors.what: the speaker acknowledges or shows understanding of another person's feelings
detectors.example: I can tell this has been really hard for you.

detectors.name: Disagreement
detectors.what: the speaker disagrees with, objects to, or pushes back on something that was said
